score.verdict: eligible as a triage second reader (every finding is still verified by Claude against the real file)

findings.claim: button.pressed.connect(_on_pressed()) calls _on_pressed() immediately and passes its void/null return value to connect() instead of a Callable, causing an error and failing to connect the signal; use _on_pressed without parentheses.

position.x += SPEED ignores delta, making movement frame-rate dependent (120 px per physics frame instead of 120 px/s), and directly setting position bypasses CharacterBody2D collision handled by move_and_slide(); velocity should be set and multiplied by delta via move_and_slide().
$Label is accessed in _init() before child nodes are instantiated/added, so label will be null and label.text on line 7 will crash with a null dereference; use _ready() or @onready instead.
Node has no 'modulate' property (that's CanvasItem); assigning it errors at runtime. Extend a CanvasItem-derived class such as Node2D or Control instead.

Off-by-one: idx <= items.size() allows idx == items.size(), causing out-of-bounds access to items[idx]; should be idx < items.size().
hp / max_hp performs integer division because both operands are int, truncating the result (e.g. 30/100 = 0) instead of returning the float ratio; use float(hp) / max_hp
take_damage() is called without the required 'amount' argument, causing an invalid call error

Erasing from 'enemies' while iterating over it with 'for e in enemies' shifts subsequent elements and causes the next enemy to be skipped, so consecutive dead enemies may not all be pruned. Iterate over a copy or iterate backwards.
emit_signal uses misspelled signal name 'helth_changed' instead of declared 'health_changed', so the signal is never emitted and Godot reports an error
Timer.start(1.0) is called before add_child(t), so the Timer is not inside the scene tree and cannot start/fire correctly; add_child(t) must precede start().
SceneTree.change_scene does not exist in Godot 4.3; calling it will fail with invalid call. Use change_scene_to_file instead.
